findings.title: Priority-based scheduling: field exists but dispatch loop is not priority-ordered
findings.claim_text: Replace FIFO queue with priority queue; starvation prevention via aging
findings.expected: Dispatch loop sorts due tasks by ScheduledTask::priority before launching threads
findings.observed: ScheduledTask::Priority enum (LOW/NORMAL/HIGH) is declared and serialized; schedulerLoop() iterates tasks_ (unordered map) and appends to tasks_to_execute without priority sort (src/scheduler/task_scheduler.cpp:1383-1436)
findings.evidence: No sort/priority_queue call in schedulerLoop; FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS lists items as [ ] open
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): implement priority-based dispatch ordering in schedulerLoop
findings.resolution: FIXED: std::sort by priority (descending) added to schedulerLoop() after adjustConcurrencyLimit() and before dispatch loop (src/scheduler/task_scheduler.cpp)

findings.title: Raft-based distributed coordination: only gossip-based implementation present
findings.claim_text: Raft cluster integration for leader election; task state replication via Raft log; clock synchronization handling
findings.expected: DistributedTaskCoordinator with Raft consensus, log-replicated task state, and clock sync
findings.observed: Gossip-based leader election via DistributedCoordinator (sharding module) is implemented; Raft integration absent from distributed_task_coordinator.cpp
findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md items listed as [ ] open; no Raft client symbols in distributed_task_coordinator
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): integrate Raft-based consensus for DistributedTaskCoordinator

findings.title: Task checkpointing and auto-resume: not implemented
findings.claim_text: Checkpoint persistence API; automatic resume on failure; progress tracking; incremental processing support
findings.expected: ITaskCheckpoint interface or equivalent API for checkpoint persistence and auto-resume after crash
findings.observed: No checkpoint-related symbols in task_scheduler.h or task_scheduler.cpp; retry mechanism exists but is not checkpoint-based
findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md items listed as [ ] open; no ITaskCheckpoint header found
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): implement task checkpoint persistence and auto-resume API

findings.title: Grafana dashboard for scheduler metrics: not present
findings.expected: JSON dashboard definition for themis_scheduler_* Prometheus metrics in config/grafana/dashboards/
findings.observed: No scheduler-specific Grafana dashboard found; exportMetrics() emits themis_scheduler_* metrics; LoRA and shard dashboards present but no scheduler dashboard
findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md item listed as [ ] open; no scheduler dashboard JSON in known dashboard directories
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): add Grafana dashboard JSON for scheduler metrics
findings.resolution: FIXED: config/grafana/dashboards/themisdb-scheduler-dashboard.json created; covers all themis_scheduler_* metrics (stat overview, concurrency/queue-depth timeseries, success/failure rates, per-task duration and last-run, enabled-status table, $task_name filter variable)

findings.title: WebSocket event streaming for real-time task status: not implemented
findings.expected: WebSocket endpoint (e.g. WS /api/v1/scheduler/events) for real-time task start/stop/failure notifications
findings.observed: Only HTTP polling-based API in TaskSchedulerApiHandler; no WebSocket handler in task_scheduler_api_handler.cpp
findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md item listed as [ ] open; no WebSocket upgrade logic found
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): WebSocket endpoint for real-time task status event streaming

findings.title: Multi-tenancy support: not implemented
findings.claim_text: Tenant quota tracking; resource isolation per tenant; task namespace separation; billing/accounting integration
findings.expected: tenant_id field in ScheduledTask; per-tenant quota manager; namespace-isolated dispatch
findings.observed: No tenant_id field in ScheduledTask; no quota tracking code; all tasks share a single global namespace
findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md items listed as [ ] open; ScheduledTask struct has no tenant_id field
findings.issue_title_suggestion: feat(scheduler): multi-tenancy support with per-tenant quotas and namespace isolation

findings.title: Dynamic resource allocation (cgroups): not implemented
findings.claim_text: cgroups integration (Linux); CPU quota enforcement; memory limit enforcement; I/O throttling

findings.evidence: FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md items listed as [ ] open; no cgroup header includes or system calls found
